messages:
anika_cs: Quick flag  Peregrine Logistics (contact: @luis_peregrine) just signaled they want to onboard two additional teams and bump throughput. Asking for a Dedicated quote + enablement plan. :loud_sound:

luis_peregrine: Correct. Warehouse Ops and Pricing teams. Current prod is ~1.1M tokens/day, pilots could push ~3.8-4.2M tokens/day. Workload split: embeddings for semantic search + rerank, and short chat completions for operator assistant. Latency target <250ms.

derek_eng: Thanks. Can you share expected model families, average seq len, and batch patterns? That will affect GPU type and autoscale rules.

luis_peregrine: We'll use rwd-open-3b for chat, rwd-embed-2m for vectors. Typical seqs ~<=384 for chat, most embedding requests batched in 32-64. Reranks generate bursts.

derek_eng: Got it. Preliminary estimate: embedding traffic at projected load fits a 2x A10 pool if we use rwd-embed-2m at 8-bit quant. Need to plan for burst to 4 cards for reranks. Also want to instrument KV-cache to improve chat p50.

jess_product: I'll run enablement. Plan: (1) Embedding best practices + batching workshop, (2) Cost controls & observability session. Need sandbox tenant with sample data for hands-on labs.

anika_cs: I'll coordinate sandbox and collect success metrics we'll track (latency, per-embed cost, cache hit rate). Also flagging renewal: their annual contract renews in ~9 months; this is strong expansion signal -> potential upsell. Adding to Salesforce as opportunity.

derek_eng: @eng-infra-bot can you do a quick capacity sim for rwd-embed-2m 8-bit at 4M tokens/day plus embedding bursts and return recommended pool config?

eng-infra-bot: Simulation complete. Suggestion:
````
reserved_pool: peregrine-dedicated-pool
gpu: 2x A10G (base), scale to 4x for bursts
model_variant: rwd-embed-2m-8bit
batch_target: 64
expected_qps_embeddings: 78
expected_p50_ms: 35
expected_p95_ms: 110
notes: enable prefix caching for chat; schedule warmup for top N queries before peak windows
````
Estimated monthly committed compute cost included in calc.

derek_eng: That matches my back-of-envelope. Next steps for infra:
- Create ICR to reserve the pool and set autoscale policy
- Deploy canary in sandbox with synthetic traffic and sample dataset

anika_cs: Action items (tracking):
- eng: ICR + canary (derek_eng)
- product: workshops + sandbox materials (jess_product)
- sales: committed pricing + amendment draft (raj_sales)
- cs: schedule workshops, update SF opportunity, collect success metrics (anika_cs)

raj_sales: I'll prepare pricing bands and a short amendment template for Dedicated/reserved capacity. Looping legal for SLA language.

jess_product: Proposed workshop dates: next Tuesday (embeddings) and two weeks later (cost/observability). Luis are those okay for your teams?

luis_peregrine: Tuesday works for Warehouse Ops. Pricing team in two weeks sounds good. One ask: can you include a short demo on rerank batching and tradeoffs?

jess_product: Yep  we'll include rerank patterns + prompt templates. Also will provide a one-pager comparing committed vs PAYG monthly cost estimates.

derek_eng: Will add config snippet for warm starts/periodic refresh to avoid cold-cache spikes. Also will include telemetry hooks for prefix cache hit rate.

eng-infra-bot: ICR-8812 created by derek_eng. ETA pool reservation: 4 business days. Canary window requested: 48h after pool creation.

anika_cs: Great. Marking this thread as high-priority expansion signal. I'll add reminders: 7 days (ICR status), 3 weeks (pricing draft), 6 weeks (pilot health review). I'll update the SF opportunity stage accordingly. :spiral_calendar_pad:

luis_peregrine: Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll ship a small sample dataset into the sandbox by EOD tomorrow.

derek_eng: Once sandbox data lands I'll trigger the canary job and post logs here.

anika_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll capture post-workshop feedback and loop in renewals if pilots exceed thresholds. Ping this thread for any blockers. :white_check_mark:
